Stock

Model · Variant · Colour

Click a row to open it. The line under each count splits it into dealer (status OK), transit, blocked and damaged. Click a colour to list its vehicles.

Stock health · model · variant · colour

Free stock after bookings, ageing and how fast each colour sells

Physical = Vehicle Status OK. Free stock counts stock-report vehicles that are not blocked or damaged (IBND vehicles are already allotted), minus bookings that do not already have a blocked vehicle: all pending bookings, or live PB only. Negative = more bookings than free vehicles. Sales and days to sell use retail invoices of the last 90 days (MUL invoice date → retail invoice date).

Lead time · model · variant · colour

Average days between stages; n = vehicles with both dates

MUL invoice date = "Invoiced on" in the TVP status report (matches stock Aging exactly), else IBND GRN date / today − Aging. TVP date = despatched date from TVP; TVP fund date = fund received date (TVP status report, matched by VIN). Sec. desp = first IBND "Vehicle secondary dispatch date". Physical-date columns are left out until a physical date is available. Vehicles without both dates are left out of that average.

Model target achievement

Click an Arena model to open its report groups and variants

WS = MSIL invoices (dispatch report) this month, matched to target by variant code. Gap incl. pipeline = WS gap − pending plan (dispatch date after today) − pending indent − non-OMS pending. Retail = incentive sale (dockets created this month, every row with a Doket Date this month counted, as in the Excel filter), compared with the Nexa retail target. Arena has WS targets only, so its retail shows without a target. Required/day uses calendar days left for WS and selling days left for retail.
